    - text: CLASS 12 · FORMAL CALCULUS
    - heading "Area Under a Curve" [level=1]
    - paragraph: Learn the Riemann-sum idea, see how rectangles approximate area, and discover the definite integral as the exact limit.
    - text: Class 12 ADVANCED CONCEPT Interactive Lab
    - heading "INTERACTIVE LAB" [level=3]
    - heading "Riemann Sum to Integral" [level=2]
    - paragraph: Explore f(x)=x² on [0,2].
    - complementary:
      - article:
        - text: Function
        - heading "f(x)=x²" [level=2]
      - article:
        - text: Interval [a,b]
        - heading "a=0 b=2" [level=2]
      - text: Number of rectangles (n)
      - slider "Main rectangle count": "1"
      - text: 1 4 8 16 32 64
      - group "Sample point xᵢ*":
        - text: Sample point xᵢ*
        - radio "Left endpoints"
        - text: Left endpoints
        - radio "Right endpoints"
        - text: Right endpoints
        - radio "Midpoints" [checked]
        - text: Midpoints
      - button "Animate n":
        - img
        - text: Animate n
      - button "Reset":
        - img
        - text: Reset
    - article:
      - img "Riemann sum graph": f(x)=x²
      - text: Δx=(2−0)/4=0.5
    - article:
      - text: Riemann Sum (approx.)
      - heading "2.625" [level=2]
    - article:
      - text: Exact Integral
      - heading "∫₀²x²dx=8/3≈2.6667" [level=2]
    - article:
      - text: Error (signed)
      - heading "-0.0417" [level=2]
    - article:
      - text: Error (absolute)
      - heading "0.0417" [level=2]
    - article:
      - heading "FORMULA" [level=3]
      - heading "Area under a curve on [a,b]" [level=4]
      - heading "Area=lim(n→∞) Σ f(xᵢ*)Δx = ∫ₐᵇf(x)dx" [level=2]
      - paragraph: where Δx=(b−a)/n and xᵢ* is a sample point.
    - article:
      - heading "WORKED EXAMPLE" [level=3]
      - paragraph: Find the exact area of f(x)=x² on [0,2].
      - heading "∫₀²x²dx=[x³/3]₀²=8/3≈2.6667" [level=2]
      - paragraph: Our sums approach 8/3 as n increases.
    - article:
      - 'heading "IMPORTANT: SIGNED AREA vs GEOMETRIC AREA" [level=3]'
      - paragraph: Above the x-axis contributes positively; below contributes negatively.
      - heading "Area geometric = ∫ₐᵇ|f(x)|dx" [level=2]
    - article:
      - heading "When the curve crosses the x-axis" [level=3]
      - paragraph: For f(x)=x on [−1,1], signed area is 0 while geometric area is 1.
      - heading "Signed area cancels; geometric area adds." [level=2]

    - paragraph: Try y=4−x² on [0,2].
